name: Kokatorimon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. If this effect suspended your Digimon, 1 of your Digimon with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits or the [Vortex Warriors] trait unsuspends. If this effect unsuspended, that Digimon may attack.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, gain 1 memory.
